summary: Executed the single requested end-to-end flow from homepage CTA through all 4 assessment steps, submit, confirmation screen, MongoDB persistence validation, and mobile overflow check. Submission persisted correctly but owner email delivery failed due missing email environment configuration.

critical.issue: Owner notification email fails: Missing RESEND_API_KEY, SENDER_EMAIL, or OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL/OWNER_EMAIL. Assessment still saves.

integration_issues.issue: Confirmation screen appears and data saves, but owner email cannot be sent due backend env email config missing.

action_items: Set backend email env vars: RESEND_API_KEY, SENDER_EMAIL, and OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL or OWNER_EMAIL.
Retest one submission after env fix to confirm exactly one owner email is delivered and includes all answers.
critical_code_review_comments: Email configuration is hard-required but currently absent in backend env, blocking owner notification flow.
No applicant Reply-To is set in email payload (this matches requirement).
Email template includes all four required section headings plus assessment number and submission date/time fields.
seed_data_creation: Created one real submitted assessment via UI: NBB-20260804-8D94C3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only one POST /api/assessments request was observed in backend logs for this run. MongoDB record exists with full answers, UTC timestamp, assessment number, and status New Board Assessment. owner_email_status is Failed with explicit missing-env error.
rca of the issue: Root cause: backend email env keys are missing in runtime config. Repro: submit full assessment once. Observed: /api/assessments returns 201, record saved, backend.err logs 'Owner email failed ... Missing RESEND_API_KEY, SENDER_EMAIL, or OWNER_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL'. Mitigation: provide required env keys and retest single E2E submission.
